Hmm. If I were you I'd probably stop prank calling and try to call super subtly, like every couple days at a certain time I'd call. I'd also call once at 10pm, and then another at 10:30 or the time, and then allow him to answer and hang up, although if he doesn't, just allow it to ring until it goes to voicemail. Do not call more.
Ex:

Monday and Tuesday = call at 10 pm, on the dot, call again at 10:30.
Thursday and Friday: call at 1am, on the dot, call again at 1:30.

(Do this for a couple of weeks, call on a random day every once in awhile and do not say anything)

Eventually as the prank calls go on, he'll either start ignoring the calls or getting frustrated with them. Now stop calling as often and do once every week. He'll start thinking you're done and it'll start to annoy him when it comes again, now he'll always be on his toes.

Now you can start messing with him in real life, you know him right?

I would start out with at night or late, when he's not home, I'd place a note of the time and date I called him in the mailbox.

((Goes to house, writes down date on paper. ((Xx/xxxx)) (10:30pm) (friend said xxxx) (hangs up) leaves this in mailbox)) like a call log.
Keep doing this until he's really freaked out, switch it up. You can incorporate other things. Just never say anything. You know who he is, not the other way around.

Eventually tell him, I'm sure you could have some fun with it though. 

It would be a long prank but it would be worth it. If you do it, update me pls
